home.title: PhotoMesh
home.description: The gallery service foundation is ready. Library and sync features will follow in later stages.
home.desktopDescription: The Tauri 2 desktop shell is ready. Library access will use authorized APIs in a later stage.

gallery.connectDescription: Connect to a PhotoMesh node you administer. Access credentials stay in this page's memory.
gallery.credentialNote: The token stays in page memory and must be re-entered after closing or refreshing this page.
gallery.timelineDescription: Originals stay on their source nodes; this view shows the authorized index and availability.
gallery.emptyLibrary: This library has no photos yet
gallery.emptyHint: Photos appear here after an authorized node indexes them.
gallery.sourceOffline: The original source is currently unavailable.
gallery.addTag: Add a tag or create a virtual album
gallery.connectionFailed: Could not connect to this node.
gallery.secureConnectionRequired: Remote node connections require HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only for localhost or loopback addresses.
gallery.recycleDescription: Shows deletion tombstones from sync events. Items represent index state and never automatically delete originals on any node.
gallery.recycleSafetyText: This version provides a read-only tombstone view. Permanent deletion, emptying the recycle bin, and source-file operations are unavailable.
gallery.recycleEmpty: No active tombstones in this library
gallery.settingsDescription: Manage the current node connection, pairing trust, and this device's thumbnail cache.
gallery.nodeConnectionDescription: Change the API address or update access credentials held in this page session. Remote nodes require HTTPS; HTTP is allowed only for localhost or loopback addresses.
gallery.pairingDescription: Connect nodes with a short-lived QR invitation. Verify its source and Peer ID before pairing.
gallery.inviteTtl: Invitations are short-lived and can only be used once.
gallery.inviteShortLived: The QR contains a short-lived secret. Do not share it publicly.
gallery.scanInvitePlaceholder: Paste the QR code JSON here…
gallery.noTrustedNodes: No devices are paired with this node, or pairing is unavailable.
gallery.revokeConfirm: Revoke trust for this node? Existing connections will close.
gallery.localCacheDescription: Clears only regenerable thumbnails on this device. It does not change the library index or any source files.
gallery.clearCacheConfirm: Clear regenerable thumbnails for node {node} on this device? Only browser/desktop thumbnails will be deleted; the library index and source files will not be changed.
gallery.tagPrivacy: Tags and virtual albums are stored on this device and do not change the node index.
